    AI Overview
    The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Sweet 16 and Elite Eight rounds will be held in four regional locations: Houston (South - Toyota Center), San Jose, Calif. (West - SAP Center), Chicago (Midwest - United Center), and Washington, D.C. (East - Capital One Arena). Matches take place March 26–29, 2026. 
    2026 Sweet 16 Regional Locations: 
    • South Regional: Houston, TX (Toyota Center)
    • West Regional: San Jose, CA (SAP Center)
    • Midwest Regional: Chicago, IL (United Center)
    • East Regional: Washington, D.C. (Capital One Arena) 
    Schedule & Key Details: 
    • Dates: The games are scheduled for March 26-27 (Sweet 16) and March 28-29 (Elite Eight).
    • Final Four: The 2026 Final Four will be held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, IN.
    • Venue Details: The SAP Center in San Jose is known for its steep, high-action seating. 
    These venues were chosen to host the regional semifinals and finals to determine which teams advance to the final tournament weekend.
